description: Including the specified restriction of a scoped formula back into its original language recovers exactly the original formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.include_restrictFormula.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (S : Finset L.Symbols) {n : ℕ} (A : L.BoundedFormula α n)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A ⊆ S) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion S).onBoundedFormula
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.restrictFormula S A h) =
    A
